quests.instruction: Read the passage, then choose the best answer.
quests.passage: Trains to Manchester leave Platform 3 at 7:12, 7:42 and 8:12. The 7:42 is an express and arrives at 9:05, while the other two stop at every station and take about twenty minutes longer.
quests.question: Which train should passengers take if they want the quickest journey?
quests.hint: Ask which word in the passage means "fast", then connect it to a time.
quests.explanation: The express is the 7:42. "Quickest" is a paraphrase of "express", and 9:05 is an arrival time, not a departure.

quests.instruction: Read the text quickly and answer the question.
quests.passage: Parking in Lot B is reserved for staff between 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. Visitors may use Lot A, which is free for the first two hours and costs three dollars an hour after that. Both lots close at midnight.
quests.question: How much does a visitor pay to park in Lot A for three hours?
quests.word: free for the first two hours
quests.hint: Only part of the time is charged. Work out which part.
quests.explanation: Two hours are free, so only the third hour costs three dollars. Lot B and the closing time are details you can ignore for this question.

quests.instruction: Read the text quickly and answer the question.
quests.passage: Dear Mr. Okafor, thank you for applying. We would like to invite you to an interview on Thursday, 14 November, at 10:30 a.m. at our Harbour Street office. Please bring photo identification and arrive fifteen minutes early. Best regards, Carla Diaz, HR
quests.question: At what time should Mr. Okafor arrive?
quests.hint: The interview time and the arrival time are not the same thing.
quests.explanation: He is asked to arrive fifteen minutes before 10:30, which is 10:15. One option is the interview time itself, which catches careless readers.

quests.instruction: Read the text and answer the question.
quests.passage: Beginner cooking class: Tuesdays, 6:30 to 8:30 p.m., at the Riverside Community Centre. The fee is sixty dollars for four weeks, and all ingredients are included. Aprons should be brought from home. Places are limited to twelve.
quests.question: What must students bring themselves?
quests.hint: In notices, the things you must provide are often mentioned briefly. Watch for a verb like "bring".
quests.explanation: Ingredients are included in the fee, so students need only bring an apron. Reading the whole notice avoids choosing the obvious cooking item.

quests.instruction: Read the text quickly and answer the question.
quests.passage: Free Job Skills Workshop at Central Library: Wednesday, 3 April, 2:00 p.m., in the Learning Room on the first floor. Learn to write a resume and prepare for interviews. Register at the front desk or online. Walk-ins are welcome if seats remain.
quests.question: How can someone attend without registering in advance?
options: Turn up and ask if seats are free
Pay a fee at the door
Come back after the workshop has ended
Send an email on the day
quests.correctAnswer: Turn up and ask if seats are free
quests.hint: A single word near the end describes people who arrive without booking.
quests.explanation: "Walk-ins are welcome if seats remain" means you can simply show up. Recognising a term like "walk-in" is faster than rereading all the details.

quests.instruction: Read the passage, then choose the best answer.
quests.passage: Hi Mrs. Lin, your order #4471 will arrive between 1:00 and 3:00 p.m. today. The driver will call when he is ten minutes away. If nobody answers, the parcel goes to the depot on Ash Road, open until 7 p.m. QuickShip
quests.question: What happens if nobody answers the door?
options: It is left with a neighbour
It is sent back to the shop
The parcel is taken to the depot
The driver comes back again tomorrow
quests.correctAnswer: The parcel is taken to the depot
quests.hint: Look for the sentence that starts with a condition, not the one about the delivery window.
quests.explanation: The depot on Ash Road is the fallback plan. The time window and the phone call describe the normal delivery.

quests.instruction: Read the passage, then choose the best answer.
quests.passage: Dear parents, the Year 5 trip to the science museum is on Friday, 9 May. The bus leaves school at 8:30 a.m. and returns by 3:15 p.m. Children need a packed lunch and a signed permission slip by Wednesday. The trip costs eight dollars.
quests.question: By when must the permission slip be returned?
quests.hint: Two days appear in the text. One is an event, the other a deadline.
quests.explanation: The slip is due on Wednesday, two days before the Friday trip. Friday is when the trip happens, not when the form is due.

quests.instruction: Read the text and answer the question.
quests.passage: Visiting hours on the surgical ward are 2:00 to 4:00 p.m. and 6:00 to 8:00 p.m. Only two visitors are allowed at a time, and children under twelve may visit only in the afternoon session.
quests.question: When may a ten-year-old visit?
quests.hint: Match the age in the question to the group in the text, then to a session.
quests.explanation: A ten-year-old is "under twelve", so only the afternoon session applies. The two-visitor limit is a separate rule.

quests.instruction: Read the passage, then choose the best answer.
quests.passage: Your ticket for the Jazz Night concert is valid for Saturday, 21 June. Doors open at 6:30 p.m. and the music starts at 7:30. The venue has no cloakroom, so large bags are not permitted, and re-entry after leaving is not allowed.
quests.question: Why are large bags not permitted?
options: There is nowhere to store them
They cannot be brought back in
quests.correctAnswer: There is nowhere to store them
quests.hint: Find the word "so" and think about what comes just before it.
quests.explanation: No cloakroom means no place to leave bags, and "so" links that to the rule. Re-entry is a different rule listed in the same sentence.

quests.instruction: Read the text and answer the question.
quests.passage: Booking confirmed: two nights at the Alder Hotel, arriving Friday 6 June and leaving Sunday 8 June. Breakfast is included on Saturday and Sunday. Free cancellation is available until 48 hours before arrival.
quests.question: Until when can guests cancel for free?
quests.hint: The deadline is given in hours, but the options are in days.
quests.explanation: Forty-eight hours equals two days. Converting units quickly is a real-life reading skill for bookings and deadlines.

quests.instruction: Read the passage, then choose the best answer.
quests.passage: A fire drill will take place next Wednesday at some point between 10:00 and noon. Staff will not be told the exact time. When the alarm sounds, leave by the nearest stairs, not the lifts, and meet in the car park behind the building.
quests.question: Where should staff gather after leaving the building?
options: At the main entrance on the ground floor
In the car park behind the building
Beside the nearest lift on their floor
quests.correctAnswer: In the car park behind the building
quests.hint: The route out and the meeting point are two different pieces of information.
quests.explanation: The stairs are the route, and the car park is where people meet. Separating "how" from "where" avoids mixing up the two.

quests.instruction: Read the text quickly and answer the question.
quests.passage: Join our riverside clean-up on Sunday, 15 September. Meet at the boat ramp at 9:00 a.m.; gloves and bags are supplied. The event ends with a free lunch at noon, provided by a local bakery. Under-16s must come with an adult.
quests.question: Who must be accompanied by an adult?
quests.hint: One short label near the end of the notice names the group with a rule.
quests.explanation: "Under-16s" are the group that needs an adult. The other options are details from earlier in the notice that do not carry that rule.

quests.instruction: Read the passage, then choose the best answer.
quests.passage: The airport shuttle runs every thirty minutes from 5:00 a.m. to 11:30 p.m. It stops at Terminal 1 first and Terminal 2 five minutes later. A single ticket is twelve dollars, or twenty dollars for a return valid for a month.
quests.question: How long is a return ticket valid?
quests.hint: Numbers appear in nearly every phrase. Match the one that belongs to the return ticket.
quests.explanation: The return ticket costs twenty dollars and is valid for a month. The other numbers describe frequency, stops and single fares.

quests.instruction: Read the text quickly and answer the question.
quests.passage: Order 7820 has been dispatched with three items. The shoes and the belt are in one parcel and should arrive by Friday, while the jacket is shipped separately and may come a day later. You can track both parcels using the link below.
quests.question: Which item may arrive after the others?
quests.hint: Look for the item that is treated differently from the rest.
quests.explanation: The jacket travels alone and may be a day late. Shoes and belt arrive together, so neither of them is delayed.

quests.instruction: Read the passage, then choose the best answer.
quests.passage: Junior swimming lessons run in eight-week blocks. Beginners meet on Mondays at 4:00 p.m., improvers on Wednesdays at 4:30, and advanced swimmers on Saturdays at 9:00 a.m. Each lesson lasts forty-five minutes, and new blocks begin in January, May and September.
quests.question: How many times a year does a new block begin?
quests.hint: You do not need to count days or classes here. Find the list of months.
quests.explanation: January, May and September make three start dates. "Eight" is the length of a block in weeks, a number placed nearby to distract you.

quests.instruction: Read the passage, then choose the best answer.
quests.passage: Because of Sunday's marathon, Main Street will be closed from 7:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. Buses on routes 5 and 9 will be diverted along Garden Road. Residents can still reach their homes by car but should enter from the north side.
quests.question: Which bus routes will be diverted?
quests.hint: Look for the sentence that says what happens to public transport, not to cars.
quests.explanation: Routes 5 and 9 use Garden Road. Cars are handled in a separate sentence, so keeping the topics apart saves rereading.

quests.instruction: Read the passage, then choose the best answer.
quests.passage: Lost property is kept for thirty days at the main office. Umbrellas, keys and phones are stored separately in the security room and can be collected between 9:00 and 5:00 with photo identification. Unclaimed items are donated to charity.
quests.question: Where are lost phones kept?
quests.hint: The general rule and the special rule name different places. Which one covers phones?
quests.explanation: The general storage is the main office, but phones are on the special list, so they go to the security room.

quests.instruction: Read the text quickly and answer the question.
quests.passage: Registration opens at 8:30 a.m. in the main hall. The opening speech, by Dr. Sun, begins at 9:15 and is followed by three workshops running at the same time in rooms 1, 2 and 3. Lunch is served at 12:30 in the atrium.
quests.question: What happens straight after Dr. Sun's speech?
options: A tour of the three rooms
quests.hint: Find the speech in the timeline, then move one step forward.
quests.explanation: "Followed by" shows the next item is the group of workshops. Lunch comes much later.

quests.instruction: Read the text and answer the question.
quests.passage: The written exam lasts ninety minutes. You may use a pen or pencil, but not a calculator or a dictionary. Phones must be switched off and left in your bag at the front of the room. Anyone finishing early must remain seated until the end.
quests.question: What are candidates allowed to use?
quests.hint: Three items are forbidden and one is allowed. Watch for the negative word.
quests.explanation: Only pens and pencils are permitted. Phones must be left in bags, and calculators and dictionaries are ruled out with "not."

quests.instruction: Read the passage, then choose the best answer.
quests.passage: The rental price includes unlimited kilometres and basic insurance. Drivers must be at least twenty-five and hold a licence for two years. The car should be returned with a full tank; otherwise, a refuelling charge applies.
quests.question: What happens if the car is returned without a full tank?
options: The driver pays for more kilometres
quests.hint: A word meaning "if not" introduces the consequence.
quests.explanation: "Otherwise" links the empty tank to a refuelling charge. Kilometres and insurance are mentioned as inclusions, so they are unaffected.

quests.instruction: Read the text quickly and answer the question.
quests.passage: During the holiday period, the science museum will close early at 3:00 p.m. on 24 December and remain closed on 25 and 26 December. Regular opening hours, from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., resume on 27 December.
quests.question: On which date does the museum return to normal hours?
quests.hint: The answer is a date attached to a verb about something starting again.
quests.explanation: "Resume" tells you normal hours come back on the 27th. The 24th is only an early closing.

quests.instruction: Read the passage, then choose the best answer.
quests.passage: Water to Building C will be turned off on Tuesday from 9:00 a.m. to about 1:00 p.m. while pipes are repaired. Residents should fill containers beforehand. Toilets in Building D can be used during the shutoff, and the office will hand out bottled water at noon.
quests.question: Where can residents of Building C use a toilet during the shutoff?
quests.hint: Decide which sentence is about toilets, then check the building name.
quests.explanation: Building D's toilets remain available. The office only provides drinking water, which is a different need.

quests.instruction: Read the text quickly and answer the question.
quests.passage: Part-time shop assistant wanted at Greenleaf Books, fifteen hours a week, mainly weekends. No experience is necessary, but good communication skills are important. Send your resume by 30 June. Interviews will be held in the first week of July.
quests.question: When will interviews take place?
quests.hint: A phrase about a week of a month can be restated more simply.
quests.explanation: "The first week of July" means early July. The 30 June date is the application deadline.

quests.instruction: Read the passage, then choose the best answer.
quests.passage: The Harbour Festival opens on Friday evening with a fireworks show at nine. On Saturday there will be food stalls from noon and live bands from four o'clock. Sunday is family day, with free boat rides until three.
quests.question: When can visitors ride boats for free?
quests.hint: Keep an eye on the day and the time limit together.
quests.explanation: Free rides belong to Sunday and stop at three. The other choices belong to different events or the wrong end of the time window.

quests.instruction: Read the text quickly and answer the question.
quests.passage: Dear members, tonight's yoga class is cancelled because the instructor is ill. The Thursday class will run as normal. If you booked online, your credit will be added to your account automatically; if you paid at the desk, please ask for a voucher.
quests.question: What should members who paid at the desk do?
quests.hint: Two groups of members receive different instructions. Match yours.
quests.explanation: Desk payers ask for a voucher. The automatic credit applies only to people who booked online.

quests.instruction: Read the passage, then choose the best answer.
quests.passage: From 1 September, the number 22 bus will leave Central Station at 6:05 instead of 6:15 and every twenty minutes after that. The last bus will still depart at 11:40 p.m. Sunday evening services are unchanged.
quests.question: What is different about the number 22 bus from 1 September?
options: The first bus leaves ten minutes earlier
It no longer runs late on Sunday evenings
quests.correctAnswer: The first bus leaves ten minutes earlier
quests.hint: A phrase of replacement signals the change. Compare the two times it links.
quests.explanation: Moving from 6:15 to 6:05 makes the first bus ten minutes earlier. The last bus and Sunday services are explicitly unchanged.

quests.instruction: Read the text quickly and answer the question.
quests.passage: Latecomers will not be seated until a suitable break in the performance. Tonight's play has two acts with a twenty-minute interval between them. Photography is not permitted, and phones must be switched off.
quests.question: How long is the break between the acts?
quests.hint: A specialist word for a break in a show points to the number you need.
quests.explanation: The interval is twenty minutes. Understanding that "interval" means the break between acts is the whole task here.

quests.instruction: Read the passage, then choose the best answer.
quests.passage: Weather alert: strong winds are expected along the coast from late Thursday night until Friday afternoon. Ferries may be delayed or cancelled, and some coastal roads could be closed. Residents should secure loose objects outside their homes and check the council website for updates every few hours.
quests.question: When are the strong winds expected to end?
quests.hint: One word marks the end of the period, and the time comes right after it.
quests.explanation: "Until Friday afternoon" marks the end. Thursday night is when the winds start.

quests.instruction: Read the text and answer the question.
quests.passage: Registration for autumn courses opens on 2 August for current students and on 9 August for everyone else. Courses fill in order of registration, so early sign-up is recommended. Fees are due within fourteen days, and unpaid places are released to the waiting list.
quests.question: When can new students begin registering?
quests.hint: Two dates belong to two different groups of people.
quests.explanation: New students count as "everyone else", so their date is 9 August. The 2 August date is for current students.

quests.instruction: Read the text and answer the question.
quests.passage: You may return any unopened product within thirty days of purchase for a full refund. After thirty days but within ninety, we can offer store credit instead. Opened items cannot be returned unless they are faulty. Please bring your receipt.
quests.question: What can a customer receive for an unopened item returned after forty days?
quests.hint: Decide which time period forty days falls into before reading the options.
quests.explanation: Forty days is beyond thirty but within ninety, so store credit applies. The full refund is only for the first thirty days.
